      "status_by_id": "rc:4405115790",
      "status_by_quote": "I think it's a good idea to clean this up now, thanks. Taking the suggestion and tweaking a bit more on top (comments an"

      "part": 1,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "usefulness",
      "text": "What is the benefit of allowing HTTP over unix sockets compared to using IPC over unix sockets, given executeRpc() is already exposed through IPC?",
      "quote": "What is the benefit of allowing HTTP over unix sockets compared to using IPC over unix sockets?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",

      "other_replies": [],
